item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  rintro -
  apply List.Sublist.subset
  fun_induction extractOldExprVars post <;>
    repeat' first | apply List.Sublist.append | apply List.nil_sublist | apply List.Sublist.refl
  all_goals assumption
EOF
python tools.py check candidate.lean"
